purpose: Tool loop of server/ws-handler.ts extended with compact_context interception (sole-call rule, explicit error tool_results, budget accounting, chat.done.compaction), plus the small compact-context-tool executor registration deliverable and the wire/transport carriage of the compaction payload.

public_api.name: CompactContextExecutor
public_api.description: Definition {id 'compact-context', name 'compact_context', inputSchema summary(string, pattern \S) required + optional remaining_work string, additionalProperties false}; registered in the static dispatcher and every connection dispatcher after web-search and curl, before McpBridge.

public_api.name: parseCompactContextArgs
public_api.signature: (args: unknown) => { ok: true; summary: string; remainingWork?: string } | { ok: false; error: string }
public_api.description: Boundary validation used by the loop; never throws; remainingWork omitted when absent/blank.

public_api.name: COMPACT_CONTEXT_TOOL_ID / COMPACT_CONTEXT_ACK
public_api.description: Stable tool id and the neutral acknowledgement content of the recorded tool_result.

public_api.name: CompactionPayload
public_api.signature: { toolCallStepId: string; summary: string; remainingWork?: string }
public_api.description: Seam S-COMPACTION-WIRE; declared in server/types.ts and src/types/chat.ts (duplicated, no cross-import); optional on chat.done.

public_api.name: StreamRequest.onCompaction
public_api.description: BackendClient calls it with the chat.done payload just before the stream promise resolves with the steps (resolve type unchanged).

owned_data: toolCallCount accounting (every tool call incl. rejected compact_context counts)
